3.name: Psionic Spells
3.notes:
You always have the following spells prepared at the listed Sorcerer levels:

3rd: Arms of Hadar, Calm Emotions, Detect Thoughts, Dissonant Whispers, Mind Sliver
5th: Hunger of Hadar, Sending
7th: Evard's Black Tentacles, Summon Aberration
9th: Rary's Telepathic Bond, Telekinesis

3.name: Telepathic Speech
3.notes:
As a Bonus Action, choose one creature you can see within 30 feet. You and the creature can communicate telepathically while within a number of miles equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1 mile). Both of you must use a language the other knows to understand each other.

The connection lasts a number of minutes equal to your Sorcerer level and ends early if you use this ability to connect to a different creature.

6.name: Psionic Sorcery
6.notes:
When you cast a level 1+ spell from your Psionic Spells feature, you may cast it by expending spell slots as normal, or instead by spending Sorcery Points equal to the spell’s level.

If you cast it with Sorcery Points, it has no Verbal or Somatic components and requires no Material components unless they are consumed or have a listed cost.

6.name: Psychic Defenses
6.notes: You have Resistance to Psychic damage and Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Charmed or Frightened condition.

14.name: Revelation in Flesh
14.notes:
As a Bonus Action, spend 1 or more Sorcery Points to alter your body for 10 minutes. For each Sorcery Point spent, choose one benefit below; each chosen benefit lasts until the effect ends:

Aquatic Adaptation. Swim Speed equal to twice your Speed; you can breathe underwater; gills or similar adaptations appear.

Glistening Flight. Fly Speed equal to your Speed and you can hover; your skin glistens with mucus or otherworldly light.

See the Invisible. You can see Invisible creatures within 60 feet that are not behind Total Cover; your eyes become black or writhing sensory tendrils.

Wormlike Movement. Your body and gear become slimy and pliable; you can move through spaces as narrow as 1 inch, and spend 5 feet of movement to escape nonmagical restraints or the Grappled condition.

18.name: Warping Implosion
18.notes:
As a Magic action, teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 120 feet. Immediately after you disappear, each creature within 30 feet of the space you left makes a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC.

On a failed save, a creature takes 3d10 Force damage and is pulled straight toward your former space, ending in the nearest unoccupied space. On a successful save, it takes half damage and is not pulled.

Once you use this feature, you cannot use it again until you finish a Long Rest, unless you spend 5 Sorcery Points (no action required) to restore its use.
